data_quality.notes: Gold review: China Southern baggage pricing splits between domestic excess charged by a published-fare percentage formula and international/regional route-area tables. Gate-checked carry-ons can create baggage charges when cabin baggage exceeds published limits.

fees.conditions: Economy Class: 1 cabin bag up to 8 kg; Business and First Class have higher allowances; size limits apply

data_quality.notes: Cabin baggage that exceeds published limits may be checked and charged at the gate, so the carry-on risk is enforcement at boarding rather than a standard carry-on purchase fee.

fees.conditions: Allowance depends on route, cabin, fare brand, and whether the route uses kg or piece rules

data_quality.notes: Official tables show domestic allowances such as 20 kg Economy / Premium Economy, 30 kg Business, and 40 kg First, while international Economy/Premium Economy allowance changes by route and fare brand.

fees.amount: Domestic formula or international/regional route table
fees.conditions: Domestic excess is formula-based; international excess depends on route area, currency, piece count, weight, and size
fees.applies_to: All fares (where additional bags are permitted)

data_quality.notes: China Southern lists domestic excess as a fare-percentage calculation and international charges by route area; combined piece, weight, and size excess can be charged together.

fees.conditions: Sky Pearl Gold and Silver extra checked baggage differs on weight-based versus piece-based routes
fees.applies_to: Eligible Sky Pearl and SkyTeam elite members

data_quality.notes: Sky Pearl Gold/Silver benefits differ by concept: extra kilograms on weight-based routes and an additional piece on piece-based routes.

fees.amount: Examples CNY 390-3,000 / USD 65-495 by route band
fees.conditions: International overweight depends on area and weight band; domestic overweight uses a per-kg fare formula

data_quality.notes: China Southern publishes separate overweight bands such as 23-28 kg, 28-32 kg, and in some areas 32-45 kg; charges can stack with extra-piece or oversize fees.

fees.amount: Depends on item, route, and baggage concept
fees.conditions: Sports equipment may count toward allowance if within ordinary limits; excess rules still apply

data_quality.notes: The special-baggage rule is not a separate universal fee list for every item: the traveler still has to check whether the item exceeds piece, weight, or size limits for the itinerary.

fees.conditions: International oversize charges depend on route area and currency; gate-checked carry-ons can be charged

data_quality.notes: Published international/regional tables show 159-203 cm oversize charges by area, and China Southern warns that multiple exceeded limits are charged accumulatively.
